description: This file defines the class Image_Canvas_ImageMap, which extends Image_Canvas to handle output as an HTML image map, including methods for adding map areas, drawing shapes, and rendering the map as HTML.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_ImageMap
classes.description: Class for handling output as a HTML imagemap, extending Image_Canvas with methods for adding map areas and generating HTML map output.

methods.name: _addMapTag
methods.description: Adds an area tag to the image map with specified shape, coordinates, and parameters.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line and adds a corresponding map area if URL is provided.

methods.name: polygon
methods.description: Draws a polygon and adds map areas for vertices or the entire shape based on parameters.

methods.name: rectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle and adds a map area if URL is provided.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse or circle and adds a map area if URL is provided.

methods.name: pieslice
methods.description: Draws a pie slice shape and adds a map area if URL is provided.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Outputs the canvas and the HTML image map if any areas are defined.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the HTML image map to a specified file.

methods.name: toHtml
methods.description: Generates the HTML code for the image map with all defined areas.
